title: Nikon Z 9 Stacked Flagship Full-Frame
purpose: Flagship stacked full-frame reference baseline with NIKKOR Z Plena optics and zero rolling shutter.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35mm full-frame stacked CMOS without mechanical shutter
sensor_and_optics.lens: NIKKOR Z 135mm f/1.8 S Plena (14/16 elements, 11 rounded blades)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15 stops dynamic range with High-Efficiency RAW
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Pure electronic stacked sensor readout with 1/200s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Flash-dominated exposure with strobe to freeze micro motion, 1/200s sync, ISO 64
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Harder key light 35 to 45 degrees off-axis for defined texture and edge contrast, strong negative fill close to face on shadow side, dark background to prevent spill

surface_rendering: Hyper-detailed epidermal skin texture with resolved pores and natural dermal micro-relief
Pristine corner-to-corner acutance characteristic of Plena optics with zero vignetting
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, micro-abrasions, uncompressed specular highlight roll-off
No digital sharpening halos, no diffusion, no haze
depth_and_optics: Focus locked on the near eye with eyelashes and iris tack sharp, absolute zero motion blur
Telephoto perspective compression at 135mm with f/5.0 depth of field stability
Zero perspective distortion, clean rectilinear projection

execution_directive: Enforce stacked full-frame raw fidelity at 45.7MP with ISO 64 base sensitivity and NIKKOR Plena telephoto compression.
